snippet.title: Tanks Rebirth Trailer
snippet.description:
Tanks Rebirth is a faithful recreation of the Tanks gamemode from Wii Play. This game is entirely free and there is no monetary benefit from the game itself.

Download the game: https://github.com/RighteousRyan1/TanksRebirth/releases
Join the discord server: https://discord.gg/zkv4jEaJnk 
Support me: https://ko-fi.com/righteousryan

#wiitanks #tanksrebirth
